text:
Priya (AE): Heads up - NeonHealth returned our MSA+DPA with 3 asks: customer-managed HSM, Net45 payment terms, and higher liability carveout for PHI during POC. They need sign+PO this week. Can Legal weigh in on the HSM text?

Jules (Legal): Paste their KMS paragraph here please. We can often accept CMK if we keep emergency access + audit trail and prevent key export.

Priya (AE): They sent: `Customer will provision keys in customer HSM; vendor will not have access to plaintext; vendor may request temporary decryption with customer approval.`

Jules (Legal): Ok that's similar to other customers. I'll propose: vendor will not persist plaintext; emergency access only via documented request approved by customer; Redwood retains right to perform DR ops. I'll add "no-export" clause.

Ravi (SalesOps): Finance flag: Net45 requires approval. @FinanceBot confirm process? Also procurement insists on PO before we enable the POC.

FinanceBot: Net45 needs SalesOps ticket + credit sign-off. Create Billing Approval ticket and attach the redlined MSA. Finance will review within 48 hours of PO upload.

Priya (AE): I'll push Jules' redline + conditional activation language (enable once PO attached within 5 business days) and ask NeonHealth to upload PO to DocuSign.

OnboardingBot: POC environment can be provisioned after activation flag set. Note: we recommend waiting for PO before runbook kick-off.

Jules (Legal): I'll draft the KMS + DPA addendum and drop into envelope. If customer accepts now we can route sign order: customer legal -> customer procurement (PO) -> Redwood legal -> Redwood finance.

Priya (AE): Thanks all. I'll send now and update this thread.
